description: This file implements a middleware component for global error handling in an ASP.NET Core application. It captures unhandled exceptions during HTTP request processing, logs the errors, and returns a standardized JSON error response.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Handles global exception catching, logging, and returning a uniform JSON error response.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes incoming HTTP requests, catches exceptions, and returns appropriate error responses.

methods.name: WriteError
methods.description: Serializes error details into JSON and writes to the HTTP response with the specified status code.

methods.name: UseGlobalErrorHandler
methods.description: Extension method to add the error handling middleware into the application's middleware pipeline.
